exposure: Maternal body mass index (BMI) before pregnancy
outcome: Congenital anomalies of the kidney and urinary tract (CAKUT)
cohort: The study enrolled 4619 neonates born between 2012-2020 at Kaohsiung Veterans General Hospital in Taiwan, comparing maternal risk factors in children with and without CAKUT.
finding: Maternal overweight before pregnancy (BMI ≥ 24 kg/m2) was identified as an independent risk factor for CAKUT in offspring, while no association was found with pregestational or gestational diabetes.
